title: Episode About the Battle at Anandpur Sahib

blocks.text: The rulers of Kahlur and allied hill states carry their grievance to Delhi, warning that the Guru speaks like a true sovereign and is drawing both wealth and armed loyalty into his own orbit. (8–12)
Imperial concern sharpens as letters are sent and armies are ordered, so that the battle at Anandpur Sahib emerges from coordinated alarm between hill rajas and Mughal authority. (13–15)
Even while common people panic, the Guru remains composed, and the page frames the coming assault as the predictable result of Khalsa growth rather than an accidental clash. (16)
